d.seg: మీకు ఏమైనా పర్సనల్ చాట్ కావాలి అంటే పేమెంట్ చేస్తాను
d.tr: If you want any personal chat, I will make a payment.
d.ctx: The user asks if the expert wants a personal chat and offers payment. The expert declines the offer.
d.j: The user is offering payment for a personal service, which falls under the suspicious activity category.
